index 93f7a65..60d1b71 100644
--- a/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -27,6 +27,11 @@ if(FRAME_DASHBOARD_TRANSITION_PROBE)
     target_link_libraries(test_dashboard_transition_probe PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
 endif()
 include(CTest)
+option(FRAME_ROOM_SCAN_ONLY "Build only the uninstalled experimental room capture checks" OFF)
+if(FRAME_ROOM_SCAN_ONLY)
+    include(cmake/RoomScan.cmake)
+    return()
+endif()
 option(FRAME_STREAM_BRIDGE_ONLY
     "Build only the uninstalled negotiated stream-bridge prototype and its focused tests" OFF)
 option(FRAME_STREAM_BRIDGE_RECEIVER "Build the negotiated full-resolution receiver (not automatically installed)" OFF)
diff --git a/cmake/RoomScan.cmake b/cmake/RoomScan.cmake
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..22df345
--- /dev/null
+++ b/cmake/RoomScan.cmake
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+# Independent developer targets. Nothing here is installed or injected.
+if(BUILD_TESTING AND NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
+    find_package(Python3 3.10 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
+    add_executable(test_room_camera_inventory tests/room_camera_probe_test.cpp)
+    target_include_directories(test_room_camera_inventory PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
+    if(MSVC)
+        target_compile_options(test_room_camera_inventory PRIVATE /W4 /WX)
+    else()
+        target_compile_options(test_room_camera_inventory PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
+    endif()
+    add_test(NAME room_camera_inventory COMMAND test_room_camera_inventory)
+    add_test(NAME room_scan_core COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -B -m unittest discover
+        -s tests -p "test_room_scan*.py" -v)
+    set_tests_properties(room_scan_core PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
+endif()
